note: Score every item strictly. A flattering score is useless; most profiles land between 30 and 50 on a first pass. Full marks describe what earns all the points, partial credit is a judgement call, and the reason must be stated for each score.

items.label: Headline
items.full_marks: Says who the user helps and what changes for them, includes one piece of proof, and is not just a job title. Uses most of the 220 characters.
common_misses: 'Helping X do Y' with nothing specific
a list of buzzwords separated by pipes

items.label: About: first two lines
items.full_marks: The two lines visible before 'see more' name the reader's problem or the result the user delivers. No 'passionate about', no third-person bio, does not start with the user's name.

items.label: About: body
items.full_marks: Written to one reader: their problem, what the user does about it, one concrete proof point with a number, and a clear next step. Under about 1,400 characters.

items.label: Featured section
items.full_marks: Three items: the strongest post, a proof asset (case study, portfolio, talk), and a way to get in touch.

items.label: Profile photo
items.full_marks: Recent, face fills most of the frame, good light, plain background, looks like the user does on a video call.

items.label: Banner
items.full_marks: Custom image with one line of positioning and one way to reach the user, readable on mobile.

items.label: Current role
items.full_marks: One line of scope (team, budget, customers) and 2-3 bullets that are outcomes with numbers, not duties.

items.label: Earlier roles
items.full_marks: Recent roles each have at least one result with a number. Roles older than about ten years are trimmed to a line.

items.label: Skills
items.full_marks: Top three pinned skills match what the headline promises and what the user wants to be found for.

items.label: Recommendations
items.full_marks: At least three from the last few years, from managers, clients or peers, mentioning specific results.

items.label: Activity
items.full_marks: Posted or commented meaningfully in the last 30 days, on topics that match the headline.

items.label: Custom URL and contact info
items.full_marks: Custom profile URL with the user's name, and at least one working contact method or link in contact info.
